question: How do I manage stock when I sell on Instagram, WhatsApp and my website?
answer: Keep one stock record for each sellable product and variant. Separate physical quantity, confirmed reservations and available-to-sell quantity. Record every channel's accepted orders against that same record before promising the next unit. A spreadsheet can do this at low volume; do not assume tools synchronise just because they all display a quantity.

question: How should I organise a WhatsApp Business catalogue and take accurate orders?
answer: Group products by what customers are looking for, give each item a recognisable name and explain the unit, price and available options. When a customer sends an item or cart message, confirm the variant, quantity, availability and delivery total before accepting the order. Treat a message as a request, not proof of payment or reserved stock.

question: What should I confirm before accepting a custom crochet order?
answer: Agree on the item, measurements, yarn or material, colours, personalisation, quantity, price and making time in one written brief. Distinguish an inspiration photo from a promise to reproduce it. Check your production capacity and delivery estimate before the customer confirms; save the version they accepted so later changes can be quoted separately.

question: How do I price handmade products without leaving out my time?
answer: Add the materials actually used, paid-for making time, packaging and other costs for one finished item. Then account for selling fees, delivery support and the contribution your business needs. For a target margin m on selling price, price = included cost ÷ (1 − m), before any costs excluded from that calculation. Adding 30% to cost is not the same as earning a 30% margin.

question: What information does a product page need before customers can order?
answer: Show what is included, the material or specification, dimensions, options, price, current availability and realistic preparation and delivery information. Use photos that answer scale and detail questions, not just a decorative image. Open the page on a phone and check that the selected option remains clear through the buying journey.

question: How do I turn Instagram enquiries into orders without losing the conversation?
answer: Send an interested buyer to the exact product or collection discussed, with the information needed to choose. Keep messages for personalisation and unresolved questions. Confirm the selected item, total and fulfilment promise in one order record; a profile visit, a link click and a completed order are different outcomes.

question: How much discount can I offer without losing money on an order?
answer: Calculate the discounted selling price, then subtract the costs that order will actually incur, including packaging and fees within your chosen boundary. Compare the remaining contribution with what is needed for fixed costs and profit. Higher order volume does not make a loss on each order disappear. Test the lowest-margin eligible basket before advertising a promotion.

question: Why is my published page not showing in Google or AI search answers?
answer: Publishing a page and submitting a sitemap do not mean the page has been crawled or indexed. Inspect the exact URL: an unknown URL, a discovered-but-not-crawled page, and an indexed page with no impressions need different investigations. Check crawl access, internal links and the answer's usefulness. Google AI search links require indexing; no markup or AI file guarantees selection.
